## Description

The description the MCP server sends to the model, word for word. Its rules apply to every call.

> Get the scheduled notes queue (notes with assigned schedule times). Use skip for pagination. Check hasMore in the response to know if more results exist.

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | `number` | No | Max notes to return (default 20, max 50) Default `20`. |
| `skip` | `number` | No | Offset for pagination Default `0`. |
